Southern Song.name: Zhao Gou
Southern Song.title: Emperor Gaozong
Southern Song.note: Gave up the throne to Xiaozong in 1162 and lived on until 1187.

Jin.name: Wanyan Liang
Jin.title: Prince of Hailing
Jin.note: Killed by his own officers during the 1161 invasion of Song.

Jin.name: Wanyan Chenglin
Jin.title: Last Emperor of Jin
Jin.note: Reigned for less than a day before dying in the fall of Caizhou.
Jin.note_zh: 在位不到一天，死于蔡州城破之时。

Mongol Empire.name: Tolui
Mongol Empire.title: Regent
Mongol Empire.note: Youngest son of Genghis Khan; ran the empire until Ögedei was elected.
Mongol Empire.note_zh: 成吉思汗幼子，在窝阔台即位前监国。

Mongol Empire.name: Kublai
Mongol Empire.title: Kublai Khan
Mongol Empire.note: Fought his brother Ariq Böke for the throne until 1264; named his state Yuan in 1271.
Mongol Empire.note_zh: 与弟阿里不哥争位至1264年，1271年定国号为元。

Kara Khitai Khaganate.name: Kuchlug
Kara Khitai Khaganate.title: Naiman prince who seized the throne

Goryeo.name: Wang Ho
Goryeo.title: King Myeongjong
Goryeo.note: Real power was held by military strongmen; from 1196 by the Choe family.
Goryeo.note_zh: 实权掌握在武臣手中，1196年后由崔氏家族掌控。

Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).name: Go-Toba
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).title: Emperor Go-Toba
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note: Enthroned in 1183 while Antoku was still with the Taira clan. From 1192 real power lay with the Kamakura shoguns.
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note_zh: 1183年在安德天皇仍随平氏出逃时即位。1192年后实权归镰仓幕府。

Dali.name: Duan Xingzhi
Dali.title: King of Dali
Dali.note: Captured when Kublai's army conquered Dali in 1253–1254.

jingkang.losses: Two emperors and thousands of courtiers taken north
jingkang.losses_zh: 徽、钦二帝及宗室大臣数千人被掳北去

huangtiandang.note: Han Shizhong trapped the Jin for 48 days, but Wuzhu finally broke out by burning the Song ships.
huangtiandang.note_zh: 韩世忠将金军困住48天，但兀术最终火攻宋船突围北返。

caishi.note: Soon after the defeat Wanyan Liang was killed by his own officers.
caishi.note_zh: 战败后不久，完颜亮被部下杀死。

kaixi.note: The Song general Wu Xi went over to the Jin in Sichuan, which helped doom the campaign.
kaixi.note_zh: 四川守将吴曦叛宋降金，使北伐更加无望。

zhongdu-falls.losses: The city was sacked and burned

western-xia-falls.losses: The Tangut state destroyed, the last emperor killed

caizhou.losses: Aizong hanged himself; the Jin dynasty ended

routes.name: Wuzhu's raid south of the Yangtze
routes.name_zh: 兀术渡江南侵（搜山检海）
routes.summary: Jin cavalry chased Emperor Gaozong to the coast, then was trapped by Han Shizhong on the way back.
routes.summary_zh: 金军渡江追击宋高宗直到海边，北返时在黄天荡被韩世忠围困。

routes.name: Yue Fei's northern campaign
routes.summary: Yue Fei marched from Ezhou into Henan and reached Zhuxianzhen near Kaifeng before being recalled.
routes.summary_zh: 岳飞从鄂州挥师进入河南，打到开封附近的朱仙镇，随即被召回。

routes.name: Genghis Khan invades the Jin
routes.summary: Mongol armies crossed the Gobi, broke the Jin at Yehuling and took Zhongdu in 1215.
routes.summary_zh: 蒙古军穿越戈壁，在野狐岭大败金军，1215年攻陷中都。

routes.name: Genghis Khan's western campaign
routes.summary: The Mongols destroyed the Khwarazmian empire, sacking Bukhara and Samarkand and reaching the Indus.
routes.summary_zh: 蒙古军灭花剌子模，攻破布哈拉、撒马尔罕，一直追到印度河。

routes.name: Mongol conquest of Western Xia
routes.summary: Genghis Khan's last campaign swept through the Hexi Corridor to the Xia capital; he died near the Liupan Mountains.
routes.summary_zh: 成吉思汗最后一次出征，横扫河西走廊直抵西夏都城，自己死于六盘山一带。

routes.name: Möngke's invasion of Sichuan
routes.summary: The Great Khan led his army over the Qinling into Sichuan and died at Diaoyu Fortress.
routes.summary_zh: 蒙哥大汗亲率大军翻越秦岭进入四川，死于钓鱼城下。

routes.name: Maritime Silk Road from Quanzhou
routes.summary: Song junks carried silk and porcelain from Quanzhou and Guangzhou to Southeast Asia and India.
routes.summary_zh: 宋朝海船从泉州、广州满载丝绸、瓷器，驶往东南亚和印度。

people.name: Li Qingzhao
people.known_for: The greatest woman poet of China; her later ci poems mourn the loss of the north and her husband.
people.known_for_zh: 中国最杰出的女词人，南渡后的词作抒写国破家亡之痛。
people.line_zh: 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。
people.line_en: Searching, seeking, cold and clear, so sad, so bleak, so lonely.

people.name: Lu You
people.known_for: Prolific patriotic poet who longed to see the north won back from the Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 一生写诗近万首的爱国诗人，至死盼望收复中原。
people.line_zh: 王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁。
people.line_en: When the royal army retakes the north, do not forget to tell your father at the family rites.

people.name: Xin Qiji
people.known_for: Soldier-poet from the north whose bold ci poems are full of the wish to fight the Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 由北方南归的抗金志士，词风豪放。

works.title: Remembering the Past at Beigu Pavilion
works.title_zh: 永遇乐·京口北固亭怀古

people.line_zh: 众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处。
people.line_en: I searched the crowd for her a thousand times; then, turning round, there she was where the lantern light was dim.

people.name: Yang Wanli
people.known_for: Poet famous for fresh, lively poems about nature and everyday life.
people.known_for_zh: 以清新活泼的写景小诗著称。
people.line_zh: 小荷才露尖尖角，早有蜻蜓立上头。
people.line_en: The little lotus has just shown its pointed tip, and a dragonfly already stands on top.

people.name: Fan Chengda
people.known_for: Statesman-poet known for his poems on the seasons of farm life.
people.known_for_zh: 以描写农村四季生活的田园诗闻名。

works.title: Sixty Poems on the Seasons in the Countryside

people.name: Zhu Xi
people.known_for: Shaped Neo-Confucianism; his commentaries on the Four Books became the basis of the civil exams.
people.known_for_zh: 理学集大成者，他注释的《四书》成为后世科举的标准。

works.title: Collected Commentaries on the Four Books

people.line_zh: 问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来。
people.line_en: How is the pond so clear? Because fresh water flows in from the source.

people.name: Lu Jiuyuan
people.known_for: Founder of the 'School of Mind', who taught that principle is found in one's own mind.
people.known_for_zh: 心学开创者，主张“心即理”。

people.name: Song Ci
people.known_for: Judge who wrote the world's first systematic book on forensic medicine (1247).
people.known_for_zh: 法官，1247年写成世界上第一部系统的法医学著作。

people.name: Qin Jiushao
people.known_for: Mathematician whose 1247 book gave a general method for the Chinese remainder theorem and for solving equations.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，1247年的著作给出了一次同余组（中国剩余定理）和高次方程数值解的一般方法。

people.name: Yang Hui
people.known_for: Mathematician who in 1261 published Pascal's triangle, crediting it to Jia Xian.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，1261年刊载“贾宪三角”（杨辉三角）。

works.title: Detailed Analysis of the Nine Chapters

people.name: Ma Yuan
people.known_for: Court painter whose landscapes leave a corner filled and the rest empty, nicknamed 'One-Corner Ma'.
people.known_for_zh: 宫廷画家，山水构图常只画一角，人称“马一角”。

works.title: Walking on a Mountain Path in Spring

people.name: Yue Fei
people.known_for: Celebrated general who fought the Jin, then was executed on trumped-up charges and became a symbol of loyalty.
people.known_for_zh: 抗金名将，精忠报国，遭秦桧构陷冤死。

people.name: Han Shizhong
people.known_for: General who trapped the Jin army of Wuzhu at Huangtiandang on the Yangtze in 1130.
people.known_for_zh: 抗金名将，黄天荡困金兀术。

people.name: Liang Hongyu
people.known_for: Wife of Han Shizhong who beat the war drums at Huangtiandang and fought the Jin alongside him.
people.known_for_zh: 韩世忠之妻，黄天荡击鼓助战的巾帼英雄。

people.name: Qin Hui
people.known_for: Chancellor who negotiated the Shaoxing peace with the Jin and engineered Yue Fei's execution.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋宰相，主和议，构陷岳飞。

people.name: Zhao Gou (Emperor Gaozong of Song)
people.known_for: Founding emperor of the Southern Song who made Lin'an the capital and sought peace with the Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋开国皇帝，定都临安，与金议和。

people.name: Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu)
people.known_for: Jin prince and general who led invasions of the Southern Song and opposed Yue Fei.
people.known_for_zh: 金朝名将，即金兀术，多次南侵。

people.name: Wanyan Liang (Prince of Hailing)
people.known_for: Jin emperor who moved the capital to Zhongdu and was killed after his failed invasion of Song in 1161.
people.known_for_zh: 金海陵王，迁都中都，南侵失败被弑。

people.name: Yu Yunwen
people.known_for: Scholar-official who rallied Song troops to defeat the Jin at the Battle of Caishi in 1161.
people.known_for_zh: 文臣督师，采石之战大败金军。

people.name: Wu Jie
people.known_for: Defended Sichuan from the Jin with victories at Heshangyuan and Xianrenguan.
people.known_for_zh: 坚守川陕，和尚原、仙人关大败金军。

people.name: Zong Ze
people.known_for: Held Kaifeng against the Jin in 1127–1128 and urged the court to return north.
people.known_for_zh: 东京留守，坚守开封，临终三呼“过河”。

people.name: Chen Liang
people.known_for: Utilitarian thinker of the Yongkang school who debated Zhu Xi on morality and practical results.
people.known_for_zh: 永康学派代表，与朱熹进行“王霸义利之辩”。

people.name: Ye Shi
people.known_for: Leader of the Yongjia school emphasizing practical statecraft and commerce.
people.known_for_zh: 永嘉学派集大成者，主张事功之学。

people.name: Lü Zuqian
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian who co-compiled Reflections on Things at Hand with Zhu Xi and hosted the Goose Lake debate.
people.known_for_zh: 与朱熹合编《近思录》，促成鹅湖之会。

people.name: Zhang Shi
people.place_zh: 潭州岳麓书院（今湖南长沙）
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian of the Huxiang school who taught at Yuelu Academy and corresponded with Zhu Xi.
people.known_for_zh: 湖湘学派代表，主讲岳麓书院。

people.name: Jiang Kui
people.known_for: Ci poet and composer whose lyrics survive with musical notation.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋词人、音乐家，自度曲附有旁谱。

people.name: Liu Kezhuang
people.known_for: Leading poet of the Jianghu school and a patriotic ci writer.
people.known_for_zh: 江湖诗派领袖，豪放派词人。

people.name: Jia Sidao
people.known_for: Powerful late Southern Song chancellor whose defeat at Dingjiazhou in 1275 sealed the dynasty's fate.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋末权相，丁家洲兵败，导致南宋覆亡。

people.name: Meng Gong
people.known_for: General who helped destroy the Jin at Caizhou in 1234 and then held the Jing-Xiang front against the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 联蒙灭金，后坚守京湖抗蒙。

people.name: Yu Jie
people.known_for: Built mountain fortresses such as Diaoyu Fortress to defend Sichuan against the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 筑钓鱼城等山城防御体系抗蒙。

people.name: Xia Gui
people.known_for: Court landscape painter who, with Ma Yuan, founded the one-corner Ma-Xia school.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋画院画家，与马远并称“马夏”。

works.title: Pure and Remote View of Streams and Hills

people.name: Liang Kai
people.known_for: Painter who left the court academy and pioneered spontaneous abbreviated-brush ink painting.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋画家，开创减笔写意人物画。

people.name: Li Tang
people.known_for: Landscape painter who bridged Northern and Southern Song styles and revived the court academy in Lin'an.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋四家之首，承前启后的山水画家。

works.title: Wind in Pines Among a Myriad Valleys

people.name: Muqi Fachang
people.known_for: Chan monk painter whose spontaneous ink works deeply influenced Japanese art.
people.known_for_zh: 禅僧画家，水墨画对日本影响深远。

people.name: Zheng Qiao
people.known_for: Historian who compiled the encyclopedic Tongzhi general history.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋史学家，著《通志》。

people.name: Zhou Qufei
people.known_for: Official in Guilin whose book described the far south and overseas lands and trade.
people.known_for_zh: 著《岭外代答》，记载岭南及海外诸国。

people.name: Zhao Rukuo
people.known_for: Superintendent of maritime trade at Quanzhou who described foreign countries and goods.
people.known_for_zh: 泉州提举市舶，著《诸蕃志》。

people.name: Chen Ziming
people.known_for: Physician who wrote a comprehensive treatise on gynecology and obstetrics.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋医学家，著《妇人大全良方》。

people.name: Hong Mai
people.known_for: Scholar-official famous for his huge collection of strange tales and his notebook essays.
people.known_for_zh: 著志怪集《夷坚志》与笔记《容斋随笔》。

people.name: Genghis Khan
people.known_for: Unified the Mongols in 1206 and launched conquests that devastated the Jin and Western Xia.
people.known_for_zh: 统一蒙古，建立蒙古帝国，攻金灭夏。

people.name: Yelü Chucai
people.known_for: Khitan statesman who persuaded Ögedei Khan to tax rather than depopulate northern China.
people.known_for_zh: 契丹族政治家，辅佐成吉思汗、窝阔台，推行汉法。

people.name: Yuan Haowen
people.known_for: Greatest poet of the Jin, who preserved Jin history and poetry after its fall.
people.known_for_zh: 金代文学巨匠，“问世间情为何物”。

people.name: Wang Chongyang
people.known_for: Founded the Quanzhen school of Daoism.
people.known_for_zh: 道教全真派创始人。

people.name: Qiu Chuji
people.known_for: Quanzhen Daoist master who travelled to meet Genghis Khan in Central Asia in 1222.
people.known_for_zh: 全真道掌教，西行谒见成吉思汗，“一言止杀”。

works.title: Travels to the West of Qiu Changchun

people.name: Liu Wansu
people.known_for: Jin physician who founded the cooling school, attributing many diseases to excess fire.
people.known_for_zh: 金元四大家之一，寒凉派创始人。

people.name: Li Gao (Li Dongyuan)
people.known_for: Physician who founded the spleen-and-stomach school of Chinese medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 金元四大家之一，补土派创始人。

works.title: Treatise on the Spleen and Stomach

people.name: Zhang Zeduan
people.known_for: Painted the busy life of Kaifeng in a famous long scroll.
people.known_for_zh: 以长卷描绘开封的繁华市井生活。

works.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival

people.name: Zhao Ji (Emperor Huizong of Song)
people.known_for: Emperor, painter and inventor of the slender-gold calligraphy whose reign ended with the Jingkang catastrophe.
people.known_for_zh: 书画皇帝，创瘦金体，靖康之变被俘北去。

people.name: Li Gang
people.known_for: Led the defense of Kaifeng against the Jin in 1126 and briefly served as chancellor.
people.known_for_zh: 靖康年间主持东京保卫战的抗金名臣。

people.name: Guan Hanqing
people.known_for: The leading playwright of Yuan drama (zaju).
people.known_for_zh: 元杂剧最重要的剧作家。

people.name: Guo Shoujing
people.known_for: Astronomer and water engineer who built new instruments and canals for Kublai Khan.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家和水利专家，为忽必烈制造天文仪器、开凿运河。

people.name: Phagpa
people.known_for: Sakya lama and Kublai's Imperial Preceptor, who created the 'Phags-pa script.
people.known_for_zh: 萨迦派高僧，忽必烈的帝师，创制八思巴文。

people.name: Kublai Khan
people.known_for: Founded the Yuan dynasty in 1271, built Dadu as capital and completed the conquest of the Song.
people.known_for_zh: 元朝开国皇帝，定都大都，统一中国。

people.name: Bayan of the Baarin
people.known_for: Mongol commander who led the conquest of the Southern Song and took Lin'an in 1276.
people.known_for_zh: 元朝名将，统军灭南宋，攻克临安。

people.name: Wen Tianxiang
people.known_for: Song chancellor who led resistance against the Mongols and was executed in Dadu after refusing to serve the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 抗元名臣，被俘不屈，就义于大都。

people.name: Lu Xiufu
people.known_for: Song minister who leapt into the sea with the child emperor after the defeat at Yamen in 1279.
people.known_for_zh: 崖山海战败后背负幼帝投海殉国。

people.name: Zhang Hongfan
people.known_for: Han Chinese Yuan general who destroyed the last Song fleet at the Battle of Yamen.
people.known_for_zh: 元朝汉人将领，崖山海战消灭南宋残部。

people.name: Liu Bingzhong
people.known_for: Advisor to Kublai who proposed the dynastic name Yuan and planned the capitals Shangdu and Dadu.
people.known_for_zh: 忽必烈谋臣，建议国号“大元”，规划上都与大都。

people.name: Ahmad Fanakati
people.known_for: Central Asian finance minister of Kublai Khan, assassinated in 1282.
people.known_for_zh: 忽必烈的理财大臣，1282年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Xu Heng
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian who made Zhu Xi's teachings the basis of Yuan education and helped devise the Shoushi calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 元代理学家，主持国子学，参修《授时历》。

people.name: Bai Pu
people.known_for: Yuan dramatist, one of the Four Great Yuan Playwrights.
people.known_for_zh: 元曲四大家之一，著《梧桐雨》《墙头马上》。

people.name: Qian Xuan
people.known_for: Song loyalist painter who revived archaic blue-green styles and refused to serve the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 宋遗民画家，“吴兴八俊”之一。

people.name: Rabban Bar Sauma
people.known_for: Nestorian monk from Dadu who travelled to Persia and Europe, meeting the Pope and European kings.
people.known_for_zh: 大都景教僧，西行至波斯与欧洲，谒见教皇。

people.name: Hu Sanxing
people.known_for: Song loyalist who wrote the standard commentary on the Zizhi Tongjian.
people.known_for_zh: 宋遗民史学家，作《资治通鉴音注》。

capitals.name: Yingtianfu
capitals.note: Emperor Gaozong was enthroned here in 1127 before fleeing south.
capitals.note_zh: 1127年宋高宗在此即位，随后南逃。

capitals.name: Lin'an
capitals.note: Called the 'temporary capital' (行在); Kaifeng was never officially given up.
capitals.note_zh: 名义上称“行在”，以示不忘旧都开封。

capitals.name: Zhongdu
capitals.note: Prince Hailing moved the capital here from Shangjing.
capitals.note_zh: 海陵王从上京迁都于此。

capitals.name: Kaifeng (Nanjing)
capitals.note: The Jin fled south from Mongol attacks.
capitals.note_zh: 金为躲避蒙古进攻南迁于此。

capitals.name: Kaifeng
capitals.note: Liu Yu's puppet state set up by the Jin.
capitals.note_zh: 金扶植的刘豫傀儡政权。

capitals.name: Balasagun
capitals.note: Yelü Dashi's Khitan state in Central Asia.
capitals.note_zh: 耶律大石在中亚建立的契丹政权。

capitals.name: Karakorum
capitals.note: Ögedei built the city walls in 1235.

capitals.name: Kaiping (Shangdu)
capitals.note: Kublai's base; renamed Shangdu in 1263, later the summer capital.
capitals.note_zh: 忽必烈的根据地，1263年改称上都，后为夏都。
